details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:16-49 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: render_prompt.sh no longer expands {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}} even though the judge prompt templates still contain that placeholder and the orchestrator still supplies SEMBLE_PREFETCH_FILE.
  WHY: The rendered judge prompts will pass the literal placeholder to the LLM instead of Semble context, silently breaking judge behavior; the narrowed unresolved-placeholder check no longer catches it.
- tests/test_render_prompt_semble.py:38-55; tests/test_judge_prompt_semble_contract.py:22-52 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The render_prompt Semble tests and the judge contract test still assume {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}/SEMBLE_PREFETCH_FILE expansion that render_prompt.sh no longer performs.
  WHY: The render_prompt file fails outright, and the contract test now offers false confidence because it can still pass while the placeholder is ignored.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:74-76 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: SEMBLE_FIELD_RE does not recognize file=, so overflow-fallback lines get bucketed by filename instead of aggregating under target=overflow.
  WHY: The parser absorbs file= into the previous value, fragmenting the Semble retrieval breakdown table.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:147-155 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: _semble_bucket prefers phase even though the current Semble logs only emit target.
  WHY: The phase branch never fires today and only obscures the active bucket key.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:134,292-299,567-570 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The 16000-character bound and _bounded_query_text helper were removed, so full plan text is now passed directly into the Semble query subprocess.
  WHY: Large plan text can waste up to the 30-second timeout per overflow file before failing open.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:496-500 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The summary now counts marker-only entries with len(skipped_too_large), which omits missing-file and binary-skipped markers.
  WHY: When multiple marker types coexist, the human-readable summary undercounts marker-only entries and no longer matches included.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:48-53,242-247,376-381 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The script no longer sources semble_helpers.sh or appends the post-Codex Semble context block to the diagnose prompt.
  WHY: The diagnose prompt loses Semble-retrieved context even when the foundation is available, making failure diagnosis less informed.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:118-131 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The ISSUE_META_FILE path-validation guard was removed before jq reads the file.
  WHY: If the environment variable is ever mis-set, the script will read an arbitrary path instead of preserving the prior defense-in-depth check.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml, .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, .github/workflows/validate.yml, .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:n/a | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: These reusable workflows were reported as lacking the Semble foundation steps, so SEMBLE_ENABLED runs fall back to grep instead of index-backed context.
  WHY: Without the setup/install/build-index parity, consumers using those workflows would not get SEMBLE_AVAILABLE/SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE.
- agents.md:117-120 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: SEMBLE_FALLBACK is missing from the stable log prefixes list.
  WHY: Log analysis tooling that relies on the contractual prefixes would miss fallback events and underreport Semble health.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:16-49 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: render_prompt.sh removed the emit_semble_prefetch function, the {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}} case branch, and the unresolved-placeholder guard for {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}.
  WHY: The judge prompt templates still contain the literal {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}} placeholder, so the orchestrator now renders prompts with that placeholder unexpanded and silently drops Semble context.
- tests/test_render_prompt_semble.py:38-55; tests/test_judge_prompt_semble_contract.py:22-52 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The render_prompt Semble tests and the judge contract test still expect {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}/SEMBLE_PREFETCH_FILE behavior that the current render_prompt.sh no longer implements.
  WHY: test_render_prompt_injects_semble_prefetch_from_file will fail, and the contract test now only gives false confidence because it does not detect that render_prompt.sh ignores the file.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:74 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: SEMBLE_FIELD_RE recognizes target, phase, chunks, bytes, ms, reason, detail, path, status, version, source, but not file.
  WHY: targeted_file_context.py emits SEMBLE_FALLBACK target=overflow file=..., so file= is absorbed into the preceding value and overflow-fallback buckets fragment by filename.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:496-500 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The summary line now uses len(skipped_too_large) for marker-only count.
  WHY: That omits missing-file and binary-skipped markers, so the human-readable summary undercounts marker-only entries when multiple skip types coexist.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:134,292-299,567-570 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The 16000-character Semble query cap and _bounded_query_text helper were removed.
  WHY: plan_text.strip() or None is now passed directly to the Semble query subprocess, which can waste up to 30 seconds per overflow file on oversized queries.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:118-131 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The guard that validated ISSUE_META_FILE stayed under RUNTIME_DIR before jq reads it was removed.
  WHY: If ISSUE_META_FILE is ever mis-set, the script will read an arbitrary path instead of falling back to the prior defense-in-depth behavior.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:48-53,242-247,376-381 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The script removed source scripts/semble_helpers.sh, removed the build_post_codex_semble_query/append_post_codex_semble_block logic, and removed the call that appended Semble context to the prompt file.
  WHY: The diagnose prompt no longer includes Semble-retrieved context even when the feature is available, so post-Codex diagnosis is less informative.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:16-49 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The emit_semble_prefetch() function and {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}} case branch were removed from render_prompt.sh.
  WHY: The judge prompt templates still contain {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}, so rendered judge prompts will send the literal placeholder to the LLM instead of Semble context.
- tests/test_render_prompt_semble.py:38-55; tests/test_judge_prompt_semble_contract.py:22-52 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: These tests still assert that {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}} is expanded by render_prompt.sh.
  WHY: They will fail against the current code because that functionality was removed in this PR.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:74-76 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: SEMBLE_FIELD_RE does not include file= as a recognized key.
  WHY: Semble log lines with file= in overflow-fallback entries will have the filename absorbed into the previous value, fragmenting buckets.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:499 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The summary now uses len(skipped_too_large) for the marker-only count.
  WHY: skipped_too_large only tracks files skipped due to size, not missing or binary files, so the summary can no longer add up when marker types coexist.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:567-570 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The SEMBLE_QUERY_TEXT_MAX_CHARS=16000 cap and _bounded_query_text() function were removed.
  WHY: Query text is now passed directly to the Semble subprocess, which increases timeout risk and wastes runner time on overflow-file queries.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: old lines ~116-131 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The path-validation guard for ISSUE_META_FILE was removed.
  WHY: The script now reads ISSUE_META_FILE directly with jq without the previous check that kept it within RUNTIME_DIR.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
